messages:
ana: Morning — nightly eval-cache-sweep failed on inference-3, bench-run jobs 42-50 marked flaky in CI. saw a cache-sweep timeout (~30s). anyone grabbing this?
cron-bot: Job nightly/eval-cache-sweep failed on inference-3 (timeout). run=2026-03-16T05:00Z, id=run-8812
kai: I can take a look. can you paste the small log snippet from the node or the job agent?
ana: pasted below — short snip: ```[2026-03-16T05:00:03Z] sweep: kvcache evict took=30500ms node=inference-3
[2026-03-16T05:00:03Z] bench: job=47 status=prewarm_timeout
```
mike: hmm looks like a kvcache GC spike. we rolled a kernel/driver update to the inference-3 fleet yesterday night?
jen: yes we pushed kernel v5.17.9 -> v5.17.10 to inference-3 at ~03:00Z. not to inference-5/6 yet.
kai: quick triage plan: 1) rerun the failing range with cache warm disabled 2) if rerun passes, bisect config/kernel change 3) if rerun still fails, create replacement node/AMI and rerun. @mike can you /rerun the group with skip_warm=true?
mike: doing it now: `/rerun nightly/eval-cache-sweep --jobs=42-50 --env=skip_warm=true`
cron-bot: Rerun queued: new_run=r-2165432199
ana: thanks, i'll watch the bench dashboard and CI. if this recurs we should pin AMI and open an incident.
mike: rerun started — partial results: jobs 42-46 passed, job 47 still failing on inference-3 replica.
kai: consistent failure on 47 narrows it to node-level issue. can you grab `dmesg` + `journalctl -u redwood-kvcache` from inference-3? might be OOM or OOM-killer.
mike: grabbing logs now, snippet: ```[kernel] Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (kvcached) score 987 or sacrifice child
[system] redwood-kvcache[1234]: restarted by systemd at 05:00:12Z after OOM
```
jen: OOM on kvcached — memory regression likely. could be kernel or a regressed config increase. @infra-team any recent changes to cgroups or memory limits?
infra-team: we did bump kvcache default to 70% last month. no change this deploy window except the kernel bump.
ana: ok next steps: (A) create a short canary reducing kvcache max to 40% on a fresh node (inference-5) and run job 47, (B) if canary passes, roll config to inference-3 before midnight, (C) open incident doc with root-cause if kernel confirmed.
kai: i'll spin the canary with `kvcache.max_percent=40` and run only bench-47.
mike: canary node inference-5 created, bench-47 running on it... it passed.
ana: great — please apply the config change to inference-3 and mark the CI flakes as rerun-resolved when stable.
kai: applied `kvcache.max_percent=40` on inference-3 via agent, restarting kvcache service gracefully. monitoring.
mike: after config change, reran job 47 on inference-3, passed. updating CI status and closing the rerun.
ana: marking this thread resolved for now. we'll track a follow-up to bisect the kernel bump vs default cache size. thanks all! :thumbsup:
